q-275319.name: Question 1
q-275319.worked_solution:
To compute $a+b,$ we just need to compute all of the $i$'s and $j$'s, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}a+b & =(5i-3j)+(-i+5j) \\  & =5i-3j-i+5j \\  & =(5i-i)+(-3j+5j) \\  & =4i+2j\end{aligned}
$$
